sentence: This project builds models that use machine learning to study how proteins change shape during virus fusion.
This project studies how reprogramming of creatine metabolism takes part in breast cancer metastasis and which enzymes are involved.
This project supplies imaging technologies, such as confocal microscopy and adaptive optics, so scientists can observe structural changes in the visual system.
This project studies three forms of headache in youth to understand the physiological mechanisms behind them, using machine learning.
This project studies how diacylglycerol kinases bind ligands and whether drugs can target them in T cells.
This project uses machine learning and magnetic resonance imaging to study the genetic and non-genetic factors behind myocardial fibrosis.
This project provides genome editing and virus production for use in mammalian cultures and animals in vision research.
This project studies how obesity, diabetes and heart disease affect endothelial cells by measuring stress markers and gene expression.
This project studies how changes in chromatin and enhancers drive senescence and aging in mammals.
This project develops compounds that block coronavirus proteins such as the helicase and the spike protein.
This project tests how different amounts of moderate to vigorous physical activity affect arthritis outcomes and symptoms in adults with arthritis.
This project studies how bacteria, archaea, fungi and viruses in the oral microbiome change after transplant and relate to caries risk and blood infection.
This project studies how acceptable cell and gene therapy for HIV is to people with HIV and what ethical questions it raises.
This project builds statistical and artificial intelligence methods that use single-cell sequencing to decode the history of cells in tissues such as brain and heart.
This project tries to find markers and genetic changes linked to how brain metastases from breast cancer respond to immunotherapy.
This project builds AI tools that model and predict how proteins bind DNA and RNA.
This project uses machine learning to build models of glycoproteins such as mucins to understand how they work in normal and diseased conditions.
This project studies how a cation channel affects right ventricular cardiomyocytes in pulmonary hypertension and how it links to Angiotensin II.
This project studies maternal factors that link prenatal alcohol exposure to fetal growth restriction.
This project uses normal and diabetic mice with Pseudomonas aeruginosa keratitis to study why the immune response fails in diabetic corneas.
